adaptive_history: Designed after retained CRC v1/v2/v3 and stb negatives and after correctness-only CRC linear qualification. The first dual representation failed the unchanged 128-op selected-LLVM limit; the shared-body repair passed fresh qualification. No new economic sample was used to select this protocol. This is not independent statistical confirmation.
break_even: Only when the conservative observed kernel saving is positive, report ceil(preparation_component_ns * calls_per_trace / saving_per_trace_ns), and the same ratio with complete shared non-delivery cost. The additional-three-image preparation is an observed component, not a complete counterfactual deployment estimate. This is a conditional hypothesis using synthetic fixed-byte work, not observed future profit or production demand.
cost_boundary: All capture/source/tool/solver checks, six candidate proofs/compilations/native controls, shared cache construction/priming/holding/clearing, code inspection, cleanup, final identities, analysis and first RESULT write are retained. Shared non-delivery wall is charged in full to every cold comparison; no baseline-preparation credit is assumed. An outer execution receipt must additionally retain interpreter startup, final rewrite and shutdown. Human and prior tool-acquisition cost remain unknown/historical, not zero.

data.encoding: ASCII domain + NUL + ASCII phase + NUL + seed encoded as unsigned eight-byte big-endian; SHAKE256 digest of exactly bytes per phase
data.selection: All 4096 bytes of each separately domain/phase/seed-bound SHAKE256 stream. Before timing, require distinct phase payloads and all 32 256-byte request chunks pairwise distinct and nonzero. These source-frozen synthetic streams do not establish external workload generalization.

deadline_scope: 300 seconds unchanged. Check before/after bounded stages and after cleanup, final identities, analysis and first result write; failed prefixes are retained without retry. This is an admission deadline, not a hard whole-process preemption theorem.
dispatch: Known polynomial chooses linear_ieee or linear_castagnoli at request boundaries. All six static alternatives, including linear_dual, remain in the strongest fixed baseline.
economic_gate: For both phases and all workloads: min complete host time over all six coalesced fixed candidates and both repeats minus max poly-dispatch host time minus the full shared non-delivery charge must be strictly positive. Exported new code must differ from all legacy exports. An inner gate is provisional until actual outer execution cost is incorporated.
kernel_diagnostic: Report each of the three new static candidates against the minimum kernel time over all three legacy static candidates. Include all workloads, including fallback, and both phases; report per-call saving and negative values. No candidate or sample is discarded.
metric: Primary observed cost is full arm_host_wall_ns: request construction, reference lookup, evidence and trace creation, native child lifecycle, validation and first observation write. kernel_ns is a nested diagnostic, not whole-file or end-to-end latency.
ndu: No NDU arm: known polynomial static dispatch and the full fixed pool already express this task. No artificial switching constraints or withheld candidate creates a controller advantage. Retain prior real-NDU same-model exact-DP result and negative incremental economics.
ordering: Training then validation; workload order rotates by trial. Arm order rotates by trial plus workload index and reverses on odd trials.
purpose: Measure the fixed-polynomial linear proposal on the exact prior v3 CRC requests; do not extend work or lifetime to manufacture a positive result.

reference_reuse.authority: No native result, safety qualification or trace nonce is cached. Every policy executes its own actual contexts; poisoned banks never replay.
reference_reuse.key: Exact mode, seed, fixed parameter and complete values, under the immutable bank/root/checker namespace. Request ID and equivalent candidate slot remain in the consumed trace.
reference_reuse.priming: Before any timing observation, prepare and cancel four baseline traces: each phase crossed with each polynomial. No native context is executed. Charge complete preparation, lookup, storage and cancellation wall to cold setup. No oracle misses may occur in any measured arm.
reference_reuse.storage: Record exact retained canonical key+outcome bytes, entry counts, peaks, and canonical-byte nanoseconds. This is not Python RSS, physical energy, a tariff or a proof of oracle purity.

sampling: No retry, native warmup, automatic replay, outlier removal or omitted attempted sample. Two trials reuse the same fixed synthetic inputs; envelopes are not statistical confidence intervals.
